doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Flash floods and the West
summary: A flash flood in Virginia; the band never went west to Albuquerque.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: A little bit more about the different parts of the country.
What about, did you ever run into any flash floods? Yeah, it was large, yeah, it was large, sons. Uh, one time in, uh, Virginia, I can't remember the name of the place. Yeah, they're ready.
I just went right to the place. We got out of it right quick. Mm-hmm. I can't remember the river once we got out of it and nothing like that. Yeah, they're out there. Yeah.
Well, I just wanted because we've been talking about that.
Mm-hmm. And, uh, did you ever go around, uh, say, Albuquerque? No, we didn't go west.
Never to Santa Fe, Albuquerque, or Phoenix, Tucson? Yeah, we've been west there. I see. Oh, good. That saves me from talking too much.
